Player.Title: Loot
Player.DoubleClickHint: Double-click an item to take it. Closing leaves the rest on the corpse.

ManualGenerationOnly.Name: Manual generation only
ManualGenerationOnly.Hint: Loot is only created when Generate Loot is used (recommended).

RequireInvestigationRoll.Name: Require Investigation roll
RequireInvestigationRoll.Hint: Looting always forces an Investigation check from the player. This setting is kept for compatibility and cannot disable the roll.

DefaultInvestigationTotal.Name: Default Investigation total
DefaultInvestigationTotal.Hint: Unused — Investigation is always rolled by the player.

AllowAllPlayersToLoot.Name: Allow all players to loot
AllowAllPlayersToLoot.Hint: When enabled, any player can start looting: they roll Investigation, loot is generated, the DM Review window opens for the GM, and the player loot window opens for the looter. Only one player may loot at a time; leftovers go to the corpse inventory. When disabled, players who loot early are told to wait and the DM gets a Start Roll prompt.

AllowPlayerRequestLoot.Name: Allow players to request loot from DM
AllowPlayerRequestLoot.Hint: When Allow all players to loot is off, double-clicking a corpse notifies the DM to start the roll (recommended).

PreventDuplicateGeneration.Name: Prevent duplicate generation
PreventDuplicateGeneration.Hint: Block regenerating loot on a corpse that already has generated loot.

ShowLootIndicators.Name: Show loot indicators
ShowLootIndicators.Hint: Show a loot-bag icon above corpses with unclaimed loot.

EnableRareDrops.Name: Enable rare drops
EnableRareDrops.Hint: Allow uncommon rewards such as Alpha Wolf Fang.

DebugLogging.Name: Debug logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Print detailed LootForge logs to the console.
